title: Generate native 30-second videos in a single Seedance 2.5 generation for…
content:
Generate native 30-second videos in a single Seedance 2.5 generation for long-take shots.

Use Seedance 2.5 Long Video Mode to extend outputs up to 3 minutes while maintaining consistency.

Use the interactive editing tools to reshape specific parts of the frame after generation.

Provide up to 50 multimodal references (including 3D white models and green-screen footage) to guide the generation toward production-accurate results.

Use timestamp control (down to 1-second precision) to align changes or events to exact moments in the video.

Integrate Seedance 2.5 into film pipelines via Dreamina AI plugins for Maya and Blender.
